This article lists potential candidates for the Republican nomination for Vice President of the United States in the 2016 United States presidential election.

Businessman Donald Trump of New York, the 2016 Republican nominee for President of the United States, considered several prominent Republicans and other individuals before selecting Governor Mike Pence of Indiana as his running mate on July 15, 2016.
Pence formally won the vice presidential nomination on July 19, 2016, at the 2016 Republican National Convention.
The Trump-Pence ticket won the 2016 election, defeating the Democratic (Clinton-Kaine) ticket.
